ei.title: Evolution of Cultural Tourism to Daily Life
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Today's cultural tourist is just as likely to be in search of 'popular', 'everyday' or 'street' culture as they are likely to visit a heritage site or a museum. The museum seems to have lost its dominant role as a factory of meaning in (post)modern society, so cultural tourists have gone in search of meaning elsewhere. The predominant direction of expansion has been into 'everyday life'. Cultural tourism is as much based on experiencing as it is on seeing; therefore, Raymond Williams' definitions of culture as a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning are particularly relevant here. Past definitions of cultural tourism have placed too much emphasis on cultural tourism as a form of arts or heritage tourism in its narrowest sense; for example, visiting museums, monuments, galleries and theatres. Cultural tourists are also interested in the more experiential aspects of culture. In an international context, particularly in the context of indigenous or ethnic tourism, the way of life of a people can be a central focus, where the traveller is motivated primarily by first-hand, authentic or intimate contact with people whose ethnic or cultural background is different from their own.

ch: 박물관은 여전히 현대 사회에서 문화 의미 생산의 중심 역할을 담당하고 있다.
과거의 문화관광 정의는 일상생활과 경험적 측면을 강조했다.
문화관광의 주된 확장 방향은 일상생활로 이어졌다.
Raymond Williams는 문화를 예술과 학습에만 국한하여 정의했다.

questions.passage: Today's cultural tourist is just as likely to be in search of 'popular', 'everyday' or 'street' culture as they are likely to visit a heritage site or a museum. The museum seems to have lost its dominant role as a factory of meaning in (post)modern society, so cultural tourists have gone in search of meaning elsewhere. The predominant direction of expansion has been into 'everyday life'. Cultural tourism is as much based on experiencing as it is on seeing; therefore, Raymond Williams' definitions of culture as a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning are particularly relevant here. Past definitions of cultural tourism have placed too much emphasis on cultural tourism as a form of arts or heritage tourism in its narrowest sense; for example, visiting museums, monuments, galleries and theatres. Cultural tourists are also interested in the more experiential aspects of culture. In an international context, particularly in the context of indigenous or ethnic tourism, the way of life of a people can be a central focus, where the traveller is motivated primarily by first-hand, authentic or intimate contact with people whose ethnic or cultural background is different from their own.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 삶의 방식이 핵심 초점이 될 수 없다 → 원문은 '중심 초점이 될 수 있다'
det.analysis:
① 'in search of popular, everyday or street culture' — 일치.

② 'definitions of culture as a whole way of life as well as the arts and learning' — 일치.

③ 원문: 'the way of life of a people can be a central focus' — 삶의 방식이 중심 초점이 '될 수 있다'. 이 선지는 '될 수 없다'고 하므로 불일치. ←정답

④ 'in its narrowest sense; for example, visiting museums...' — 일치.
det.tip: can be a central focus = 핵심 초점이 될 수 있다. 선지③의 '될 수 없다'는 원문과 반대.

ch: 오늘날 문화관광객은 대중문화, 일상문화, 거리문화에도 관심을 갖는다.
Williams의 문화 정의는 예술과 학습은 물론 삶 전체 방식을 포함한다.
국제적 맥락에서 사람들의 삶의 방식이 관광의 핵심 초점이 될 수 없다.
과거 문화관광의 정의는 박물관, 기념물, 갤러리 등 좁은 의미에 집중했다.
